campaign: Publication PET full-event diagnosis and UQ remediation
decision_required: Choose whether the publication PET estimator adopts the fit-time LR anneal, rejects that arm and opens another normalization-remediation branch, or stops the PET publication path.
why_user_decision_is_required: The independently re-derived powered closure has the predeclared disagreement: recovery 0.512603276 passes the adopted PRIMARY 0.494582400 criterion by 0.018020876, but is 0.034249724 below the full-LR baseline and therefore triggers the SECONDARY TRADE-OFF/ARM-REJECTED reading. The anneal repairs fold-forward normalization from a 34.46% deficit to 1.17%, but a clean isolated diagnostic explicitly did not authorize changing the shared engine or promoting the arm. That scientific trade-off and the resulting estimator change are Joseph's decision.

options.description: Authorize promotion of the proven fit-time anneal into the publication estimator, accepting the quantified shape trade-off because the adopted primary criterion still passes; require a scoped engine/launcher change, complete hash-gate re-issue, and explicit nominal-launch authorization before PET production.
Reject the annealed arm because of the secondary shape trade-off and authorize a new, predeclared normalization-remediation branch; keep the current shared engine and Branch C unchanged meanwhile.
Keep Branch C closed and stop further publication PET remediation.
